# FG-REPO-0030

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `spec_trace_counts_added_tags_and_flags_unknown_and_malformed_ones` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: @req のタグが、どの要件にも、参照している仕様の範囲にも当たりません（または形式が違います）。要件 ID か PBI-<番号>/AC-<番号> を確かめてください。
- en: A @req tag names no requirement here or in a referenced specification's scope (or is malformed). Check the requirement id or PBI-<n>/AC-<m>.
- id: Tag @req tidak merujuk persyaratan mana pun di sini maupun dalam cakupan spesifikasi yang dirujuk (atau formatnya salah). Periksa id persyaratan atau PBI-<n>/AC-<m>.

## 原因 (cause)

The check `forge/spec-trace` (M3 X4, advisory) found a `@req` tag the merge request adds (a (path, id) pair not at the merge base) whose id this repository's own specification does not define and no `.forge/repo.yml` `repo:` entry's `scope:` covers (an entry without a scope covers every id), or a tag followed by no requirement id or acceptance criterion at all (malformed: `@req` then text that is neither `<ID>` nor `PBI-<n>/AC-<m>`). The referenced specifications themselves are not read by the check (the run is shown to every reader of the project), so a covered id counts as known. A notice: the run concludes `neutral`, never `failure`.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Open the run: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head> (forge/spec-trace; `unknown <ID>` and `malformed @req at <path>:<line>` lines, with an annotation on each). Compare with the requirement index: gstn spec requirements --project <id> --ref <head> and the references: gstn browse spec-refs --project <id> --ref <head>.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the id in the tag, add the requirement to the specification, or add the referenced specification's id pattern to `scope:` in .forge/repo.yml. Nothing to change on the server.
